newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $820 mln in loans for Russia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $820 mln in loans for Russia.

text.p: The World Bank approved nearly $820 million in loans for Russia on Thursday to help the country overhaul its economy and resume growth, Bank sources said.

The sources, who declined to be named, said the biggest credit -- a $600 million structural adjustment loan -- would support wide-ranging reforms throughout Russia and help the financially-strapped country provide needed public services.
The other credits approved by the Bank's board were:
-- $85 million to help recently-privatised Russian companies restructure their operations;
-- $71 million to improve higher education through enhanced teaching methods, smaller class sizes and more and better textbooks;
-- $40 million to reform the problem-plagued power sector; and
-- $22.6 million to improve government analysis of the economy.
